name: Hector Lending
rootCause: Publicly available evidence for the June 2023 Hector Lending incident remains limited. Multiple exploit catalogues report that approximately $653,000 was drained on Fantom through a token approval abuse or arbitrary calldata issue tied to a Hector Network bridge integration, but no primary postmortem or verified exploit transaction has been publicly identified. The available evidence points to unsafe handling of token approvals and externally supplied calldata in a Hector Network bridge integration on Fantom. Public sources consistently describe the exploit as token approval abuse or arbitrary calldata execution that enabled transfers of treasury USDC.…
